comment: < 3 distinctive tokens -> inconclusive -> keep (even with zero overlap)

Full paths are SINGLE tokens with regex [a-zA-Z0-9_./:-]+ (slashes are in the class), so they have < 3 distinctive tokens -> keepRecoveredItem always keeps them. Cross-project FILE paths are dropped by a SEPARATE rule at the filter sites (crossProjectFileDrop: an absolute-path prefix check against cwd), NOT by this decision function; the per-item token filter targets session-wide TEXT fields (Key Decisions).
Full path, cross-project, still kept by keepRecoveredItem (see above)
